Meqabyan (Ethiopian tradition) Second Book of Meqabyan (Mäṣḥafä Mäqabyan II) (c. 600 AD)

ADAMIC-MORTALITY DOCTRINE — 'we are all sons of Adam, and we shall all die.' Direct echo of Romans 5:12 ('by one man sin entered into the world, and death by sin') + 1 Corinthians 15:21-22 ('since by man came death, by man came also the resurrection of the dead'). Per CROSS_REFERENCE_APPENDIX-broadened parallels: 2 Baruch 23:4 ('when Adam sinned and death was decreed') + 2 Baruch 48:42-43 + Apocalypse of Moses (Greek LAE) 14:2 ('on account of you [Adam] toils and labor were assigned to us') + 4 Maccabees 18:7-8 (mother's-virginity speech, useful for navigating the persistent genre-confusion between Meqabyan and LXX 2/4 Maccabees). The Adamic-mortality doctrine is the THEOLOGICAL FOUNDATION for Meqabyan's resurrection-doctrine: humans are mortal BECAUSE OF Adam's sin, and the resurrection is God's RESTORATIVE-RESPONSE to that primordial mortality.

Meqabyan (Ethiopian tradition) Second Book of Meqabyan (Mäṣḥafä Mäqabyan II) (c. 600 AD)

ALL-SHALL-RISE eschatological-consequence (vv. 14-19; paired with seed 18:7 Adamic-mortality doctrine). The Adamic-mortality doctrine of 18:7 ('we are all sons of Adam, and we shall all die') is here paired with its RESURRECTION-OBVERSE: 'and as we all die in Adam, even so in resurrection we shall all rise.' Direct echo of 1 CORINTHIANS 15:22 ('for as in Adam all die, even so in Christ shall all be made alive') + 1 CORINTHIANS 15:42-44 (the four-fold-transformation-formula — corruption / incorruption + dishonor / glory + weakness / power + natural / spiritual). The verse establishes Meqabyan's CONSISTENT-PAIRING of Adamic-mortality + Adamic-resurrection — a structural-doublet that secures the doctrine against either-only-mortality-or-only-resurrection collapse. Per CROSS_REFERENCE_APPENDIX-broadened parallels: 2 BARUCH 49:1-3 + 50:1-4 (resurrection-of-the-same-body explicitly stated); 4 EZRA 7:32-33 (earth-restores-what-was-given); APOCALYPSE OF MOSES (Greek LAE) 41:1-3 (Adam-promised-resurrection). Tewahedo eschatology cites 2 Mq 18:14 as one of the canonical proof-texts for UNIVERSAL-RESURRECTION-IN-CHRIST.
